title: Hit-stop as the player (A/B), with unkillable goblins and the game's own numbers
intro: BEFORE YOU PRESS END: open ground, no other fights, a melee main pawn is best (Fighter / Warrior / Thief). The goblins in this test cannot die, so the party can't finish them; the numbers are read from the game. Press End to start.

steps.text: GET READY (no timer): stand in the open, weapon out. Press End to spawn the goblins and start.
steps.each_frame:
if not G_hs2 then
  G_hs2 = { by = {}, stage = "-" }
  local hc = sdk.find_type_definition("app.HitController")
  local m = hc and hc:get_method("getHitStopTime")
  local function nm(go) local n; pcall(function() n = go:call("get_Name") end); return n end
  if m then
    sdk.hook(m, function(args)
      local st = thread.get_hook_storage()
      st.hs2 = { di = args[3], hc = args[2] }
    end, function(r)
      local st = thread.get_hook_storage()
      local s = st.hs2; st.hs2 = nil
      if not s then return r end
      pcall(function()
        local v = sdk.to_float(r)
        local di = sdk.to_managed_object(s.di)
        local hcobj = sdk.to_managed_object(s.hc)
        local owner = di and di:get_field("<AttackOwnerObject>k__BackingField")
        local victim = hcobj and hcobj:call("get_GameObject")
        local d = _G.DPC_dbg
        local who = "other"
        local an = owner and nm(owner)
        if d and d.state.active and d.state.pawn_chara and owner and owner:get_address() == d.state.pawn_chara:call("get_GameObject"):get_address() then who = "played pawn"
        elseif an == "ch000000_00" then who = "Arisen" end
        local vn = victim and nm(victim) or "?"
        if vn:find("^ch2") then
          local k = G_hs2.stage .. " | " .. who
          local b = G_hs2.by[k] or { n = 0, sum = 0, zero = 0 }
          b.n = b.n + 1; b.sum = b.sum + (v or 0); if (v or 0) <= 0 then b.zero = b.zero + 1 end
          G_hs2.by[k] = b
        end
      end)
      return r
    end)
  end
end
G_hs2.stage = "-"
